title: Set up a data room
summary: Stand up the diligence data room investors expect: charter docs, cap table, financials, and key contracts — organized, permissioned, and kept current.

parts.title: Choose where to host the data room
parts.guidance: Compare data-room tools for the intended reviewers, document sensitivity and diligence process. Examine folder permissions, revocation, access history, download controls and exportability, along with cost and maintenance effort. Select a host and access model the room’s owner can operate, noting any important controls the chosen service lacks.

execution.rationale: The documented “Choose where to host the data room” work uses digital records, an online service or a remote communication channel and retains its named human owner. Agent assistance does not transfer the human decision, identity or signing responsibility.

parts.title: Assemble the core documents (charter, cap table, financials, contracts)
parts.guidance: Gather the corporate, ownership, financial and commercial records needed for the intended diligence. Use executed or final versions, reconcile the cap table and reporting periods, and identify missing or unsigned documents. Organize them so reviewers can find the evidence behind a claim. Resolve sensitive disclosures or redactions with the relevant owner before adding them to the shared room.

execution.rationale: The authored “Assemble the core documents (charter, cap table, financials, contracts)” work produces or inspects digital drafts, structured records or code from supplied inputs using file, text and code tools. Human decisions and review remain with their named owners; external publication is a separate authorization.

parts.title: Set access controls and share links
parts.guidance: The data-room owner grants each approved investor or adviser access to the documents needed for their diligence. Configure named access, expiry and download controls where supported, and test what that audience can actually see before sending links. Keep ownership of access changes clear so permissions can be narrowed or revoked as the relationship changes.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Set access controls and share links” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.

parts.title: Answer diligence follow-ups as they land
parts.guidance: Route each diligence question to the person responsible for its subject, with the relevant document and requested response date. Recheck facts and disclosure scope before reusing an earlier answer. Share the resolved response through the agreed channel, updating supporting documents where necessary. Keep unresolved questions visible until the reviewer accepts the answer or identifies what is still missing.

execution.rationale: The documented “Answer diligence follow-ups as they land” work uses digital records, an online service or a remote communication channel and retains its named human owner. Agent assistance does not transfer the human decision, identity or signing responsibility.

metadata.supportReason: Document collection and permissions are API work; the hosting choice and diligence answers stay with the founder.
